about: The falsifier: at epoch 283 the fold key's ledger holds 17 rendered/* lines, while a pass that folds every place of a copy of the same tree stands 162. An act renders its places in its gates, where nothing lands, and settles them there; the render after its landing finds them settled and folds only the root, so which capsule answered a region of a place the act moved was said nowhere.
